items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private; do not approve bounded public beta, full launch, affiliate expansion, advertising, or public data display. Evidence confirms API access but does not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, or alert on source data; current public terms point against commercial/public data use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Exact decision: maintain keep_private and authorize only read-only evidence work plus preparation of an unsent written permission request to the source provider, subject to owner approval.

Black Market Apparel capsule disposition: conditional for report-only analysis; blocked for production implementation. Existing compliance evidence passes the technical baseline, but no site-attributed revenue or measured experiment outcome supports a monetization or ROI claim. Retain only a read-only reconciliation proposal; do not deploy, spend, alter affiliate configuration, or claim revenue, margin, payback, or lift.
